start: Joined gym with a logo and at least one shop product, online

user_sees: The gym's logo (56 dp, own shape up to 2:1) and the gym's name at the top
Parts 'Shop', 'My gym', 'Ranking' with 'Shop' open first
must_not: Another gym's name or logo
'Leaderboard' broken mid-word at large text

user_sees: The logo full size with a close button ('Close the logo')
must_not: A stretched or cut logo

user_sees: The plan, hours, check in and the rest of 'My gym'
must_not: The tab jumping back to 'Shop' on its own

user_sees: The gym's name, logo and parts read again
must_not: A spinner that never stops

user_sees: Only 'My gym' and 'Ranking', with 'My gym' open
must_not: An empty 'Shop' part

start: A gym reminder notification or a What's new button asks for 'My gym' or 'Ranking'

steps.action: Tap the reminder (or the What's new button)
user_sees: The Gym tab opens on the asked part, not on 'Shop'
must_not: The tab opening on 'Shop' when 'My gym' was asked
Nothing happening on a second tap of the same request

start: The gym removed this phone (server answers BAD_KEY on the gym check)

steps.action: Open the app (or return after an hour)
user_sees: Notice titled 'No longer in <gym>' with 'This phone is no longer joined to the gym. Join again with its code.'
The Gym tab shows the 'Join your gym' screen
must_not: The old gym's plan, messages, diets or hours still on the phone
The old gym's logo kept on the home-screen shortcut without the grey-out

steps.action: Open the Gym tab with no internet
user_sees: The last known name, logo and parts
must_not: An error page instead of the kept gym
The member unlinked because the check failed

start: The gym changes its name and logo in the panel

steps.action: Return to the app after more than an hour (or pull down on the Gym tab)
user_sees: The new name and logo
must_not: The old name on one screen and the new on another

user_sees: The 'Shop' part goes; 'My gym' opens
must_not: A picked 'Shop' part left empty
